lines.text: A masked stranger hijacked Chicago T.V. in 1987. Twice.

parts.tts: A masked stranger hijacked Chicago T.V. in nineteen eighty-seven. Twice.
parts.heard: a masked stranger hijacked Chicago TV in 1987. Twice.

lines.text: The nine o'clock news. The sports report... and then, this.

parts.tts: The nine o'clock news. The sports report...
parts.heard: the 9 o'clock news. The sports report

lines.text: A man in a rubber mask and sunglasses, dressed as an eighties T.V. character.

parts.tts: A man in a rubber mask and sunglasses, dressed as an eighties T.V. character.
parts.heard: a man in a rubber mask and sunglasses, dressed as an 80s TV character.

lines.text: Behind him, a swiveling sheet of metal, mimicking the character's fancy background.

parts.tts: Behind him, a swiveling sheet of metal, mimicking the character's fancy background.

lines.text: No voice. Just a loud buzz. Then engineers switched frequencies, and he vanished.

parts.tts: No voice. Just a loud buzz. Then engineers switched frequencies, and he vanished.
parts.heard: No voice, just a loud buzz. Then engineers switched frequencies and he vanished.

lines.text: The sportscaster, live: Well, if you're wondering what's happened... so am I.

lines.text: But here's the part... two hours later, he came back. On another station, during Doctor Who.

lines.text: This time with sound. About 90 seconds of distorted, bizarre nonsense.

lines.text: And nobody could stop him. No engineers were on duty at the tower.
